    • src/Action/V1/Users/ResendOtp.go

  • Status: Completed & Compiled Successfully.

Phase 4: Reset Password

  • Target File:
    • src/Action/V1/Users/ResetPassword.go
  • Changes Applied:
    • Added the Models import.
    • Replaced raw password update with Config.DB.Model(&Models.User{}).Where(...).Update(...).

The user OTP and password endpoints still use direct table access and raw SQL for OTP lookup/upsert, password updates, email verification, and last-login updates. These flows can use existing GORM models (Models.Otp, Models.User, Models.UserDetail) while preserving authentication, captcha, email, JWT, Redis, and encrypted response behavior.

Refactor user OTP and password endpoints to use GORM models for lookups, creates, updates, and deletes.
